text:
Sara (AE): Heads-up — UnifiedHealth POC: CISO expects a single-slide risk summary + current blockers before the exec tomorrow. Need owners and ETAs.

Mike (SE): Core asks we surfaced: BYO-KMS attestation, IP allowlist & peering, SAML prod test, and throughput numbers for their ~10k MAU profile.

Carla (CSM): Dates: security questionnaire due EOD Fri, DPA comments Tue, customer expects a live POC in ~3 weeks.

Nina (InfoSec): I can handle the questionnaire. Clarify: when they say "complete traceability for PHI flows" do they want full host logs or just audit events?

Mike (SE): Both ideally. For the POC we can supply console audit events; streaming into their SIEM requires infra work.

Ash (Infra): We can export to S3 or Kinesis. Estimated ~3 eng-days to wire up streaming and validate for the pilot.

Oliver (Legal): DPA note: residency ok in eu-west-1 for pilot. Subprocessor clause needs to be limited + 30-day notification for changes. I'll draft a targeted redline.

Mike (SE): Draft risk matrix statuses (will formalize into 1-pager):
- KMS BYO: BLOCKER (awaiting attestation) — owner: Nina / Oliver — ETA: Tue next week
- IP allowlist & peering: PARTIAL (customer sent ranges) — owner: Ash — ETA: 48h for validation
- SAML SSO test: STAGING ready — owner: Carla / Mike — ETA: 48h to run prod smoke
- Throughput validation: PENDING perf run — owner: Ash — ETA: 4d for numbers

Nina (InfoSec): KMS attestation template I'll send to their sec lead: "We confirm the customer-managed KMS is HSM-backed (AES-256), rotates keys every 90 days, and retains audit logs 365 days; logs are exportable to Redwood on request."

Carla (CSM): Sending template to customer contact now (@unifiedhealth-sec).

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: `staging/enable-saml-test` (2025-06-11T09:12:03Z).

Ash (Infra): Quick perf note: selected model family shows ~120 tokens/s per GPU at seq_len=512 in our harness. Given ~120 tokens/session and 10k MAU, monthly tokens ~1.2B — recommend reserved capacity for cost predictability. I'll post the calc after lunch.

Oliver (Legal): Uploaded initial DPA redline to shared drive: https://redwood.app/drive/unifiedhealth/dpa-redline-v1 — please review and react.

Sara (AE): Action items: Mike -> 1-slide risk summary (ETA: EOD today). Nina -> questionnaire answers + attestation template (ETA: tomorrow). Ash -> perf calc + peering tests (ETA: 48h). Oliver -> DPA redlines (ETA: Tue). Carla -> collect attestation and confirm IP ranges (ETA: today). I'll compile and send to the customer before the exec. React with :eyes: when you've reviewed the DPA.

Carla (CSM): :eyes:
Mike (SE): :eyes:
Nina (InfoSec): :eyes:
Ash (Infra): :eyes:
Oliver (Legal): Will iterate on the redline and call out unlimited-liability language.

Sara (AE): I'll post the final one-pager here EOD. If a critical blocker appears, @here escalate to me immediately. :thumbsup:
